visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a digital satellite map view of East Asia, zooming rapidly into the island of Taiwan and specifically highlighting Tainan City with a red pin. Large white bold text overlays the center. (2) A transition to a colorful 2D animation style follows, featuring a large, smiling green chameleon-like creature wearing an orange scarf, standing in front of a traditional Japanese-style red torii gate adorned with paper lanterns. (3) A series of rapid macro shots display exotic reptiles, including a brown lizard resting on wood chips and a vibrant blue and purple centipede crawling within a plastic container. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor setting with a red bearded dragon wearing a white lace bow tie, posed in front of a blurred field of bright yellow sunflowers under a clear blue sky. (5) Food and artistic items are showcased: two golden-brown fried chicken skewers are held up against a decorative background, followed by high-quality close-ups of designer vinyl toys resembling red dragons with guitars and fluffy moth-like creatures. (6) Several real-life creators are introduced in medium shots; a man with glasses and a camouflage cap smiles while holding two small meerkats, and another man with blonde hair and glasses gives a thumbs-up in a brightly lit indoor venue. (7) A montage of diverse sculptures and art pieces follows, including a stylized one-eyed tiger, a white toad with internal organs visible, and various miniature figurines of Sumo wrestlers and cats. (8) Animation returns, showing characters interacting with lizards in a shop setting, followed by real footage of hands gently holding and stroking different leopard geckos and larger lizards in enclosures. (9) Scenes of a bustling exhibition hall appear, showing a dense crowd of people walking through aisles. Close-ups show a temperature controller set to 29.2 degrees and an aquarium with small shrimp and colorful fish swimming. (10) Entertainment and merchandise are highlighted: a spinning Beyblade in a plastic arena, shelves of stickers and pins, and a massive red wall of gashapon capsule toy machines in an indoor space. (11) The video concludes by returning to the aerial view of a large industrial-style building (the Tainan Convention Center) and the final animated title card with date and call-to-action text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A solo male narrator begins with a high-arousal, energetic greeting. The pitch is moderate but the intonation is highly dynamic, characterized by frequent rising contours to maintain listener interest. (2) Behind the speech, an upbeat, high-tempo electronic background track with a prominent synth melody and sharp percussive beats fades in. (3) Frequent high-frequency 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are interspersed to punctuate on-screen text changes and visual cuts, adding a sense of rapid movement. (4) The narrator’s speech remains fast and continuous, with minimal pauses, emphasizing keywords with increased volume and pitch height. (5) The mix is very clean, with no noticeable ambient room noise or incidental artifacts, suggesting a professionally mastered studio recording. (6) Towards the end, a subtle 'ding' sound accompanies the display of the date, and the energetic music swells slightly to a triumphant close.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and generate excitement for the 'Exotic Pet and Art Creative Exhibition' in Tainan. The video uses a fast-paced montage to showcase the variety of attractions including rare reptiles, designer toys, street food, and special guests to appeal to hobbyists and families.
